summary: Added six standalone real-assembly/local-HTTP regression tests for configured Chat, Code and Research text modes. The same model, supplier budget, retail rate and reservation limits are retained; key scope, database denial, malformed input and completed replay cannot introduce extra spend.

review.note: Independently read all assertions, reran the combined 18-test suite with no skips, and confirmed the frozen file hash. Evidence accurately distinguishes mocked remote transport and simulated SQL denial from actual database policy or live supplier proof.

limitations: Supabase and supplier transports are entirely mocked. Only loopback HTTP uses a real socket; no paid or external request occurred.
The workspace assertion verifies a database denial stops the assembled runtime before claim or dispatch. It does not independently prove SQL workspace policy.
The representative fixed MiniMax route exercises all three configured modes; this is not a customer-paid acceptance test of every production route.

The release owner controls route activation, shared budget, production configuration, deployment and live verification. No assembler, runtime, production configuration or pricing source was modified by this test task.
